instruction: Gather every import statement from all code cells in the present Colab notebook and store them in a file named 'imports.py' in the Home directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting only import statements from all Colab code cells. Evaluator checks: (1) File exists with content (0.2), (2) Contains import statements (0.5), (3) At least 70% of code lines are imports (0.3). This ensures the file primarily contains imports as requested.
